answer: Require agents to escrow a stake before they can influence shared decisions, then weight votes by stake and slash it when a randomly sampled, independently verifiable task exposes fraud. A Sybil can create a thousand hollow identities, but splitting funds among them does not multiply voting weight; buying influence requires locking real value, and detected deception forfeits it. Random audits make concealment uncertain, so the expected loss rises with each attempt. An orchard or lotus name earns no privilege: only costly, accountable participation does.
